about_the_game:
Purchase this DLC to host Escape the Dark Castle games. Other players do not need to purchase it to join.

1-4 Players | 20-40 mins

Recommended Age: 14+

Players take on the roles of prisoners trapped in a dark, dangerous castle. Using custom dice, item cards, and teamwork, you must overcome horrors, traps, and challenges presented on beautifully illustrated chapter cards. Each card reveals a unique obstacle that brings the story to life.

The immersive gameplay unfolds chapter by chapter, creating a shared storytelling experience where each player contributes to decisions on how to proceed. The goal? Survive every chapter in the castle deck and defeat the final boss to escape. But beware: if any prisoner dies, the game ends immediately.

Key Features:

  • Unique gameplay: No two games are ever the same, thanks to randomly generated challenges and outcomes.

  • Beautiful artwork: Large, illustrated chapter cards enhance the dark, immersive atmosphere.

  • Cooperation is key: Work together to survive the traps and horrors of the castle.

  • Challenging decisions: Every turn matters as you balance risk and reward.

Can you make it out alive, or will the castle claim you forever?
